assets.name: 鸡
assets.description: Small plump orange farm chicken: egg-shaped orange body, rounded head smoothly joined to body, two large friendly blue-black eyes with small white highlights, short golden-yellow beak, a red comb with THREE thick rounded lobes, TWO small red rounded wattles, two simple orange folded wings, a short fan tail formed from THREE thick rounded darker-red lobes, two short golden-yellow legs and feet with simplified rounded toes. Upright neutral standing bird, both feet grounded. Exactly two wings and two legs.

assets.name: 粉猪
assets.description: Very plump pastel-pink pig with round barrel body and oversized gently rounded head, short broad oval pink snout with exactly two round nostrils, two floppy triangular ears with rounded tips, large friendly blue-black eyes with white highlights. FOUR separate short sturdy legs ending in dark warm-brown rounded hooves; small short CURLY pink tail, centered on the rump. Natural quadruped standing pose, all four hooves grounded. Simple continuous rounded belly with no udder, teats or hanging underside detail.

assets.name: 羊驼
assets.description: Cute cream alpaca with plump wool-covered body, clearly upright medium-long neck distinguishing it from a sheep, small tan rounded muzzle and face, two tall upright rounded-point ears with pink interiors, a few LARGE rounded wool lobes forming a forehead tuft and puffy body. Friendly blue-black eyes and tiny gentle smile. FOUR short separate legs with small brown hooves, short fluffy cream tail at rump. No horns, no saddle. Wool is smooth big sculpted lobes, not realistic fiber or dense popcorn texture.

assets.name: 仓鼠
assets.description: A small round golden-orange hamster with very plump round torso, cream-white cheeks, cream muzzle and large cream belly patch, small round ears with pink interiors, blue-black friendly eyes, tiny pink triangular nose and small curved smile. Neutral upright sitting/standing pose balanced on TWO tiny pink hind feet; TWO small pink forepaws held relaxed and slightly apart in front of the upper belly. Four limbs total, paws simplified rounded pads with no separate long fingers. Very short rounded tail nub visible only at rear. Smooth sculpted clay/vinyl, no fur strands, no whisker wires.

assets.name: 兔子
assets.description: Cute plump gray rabbit with large rounded head, TWO tall upright gray ears with warm pink inner faces and rounded tips, cream muzzle, chest and belly patch, large blue-black friendly eyes, tiny pink nose and curved smile. Neutral upright rabbit pose on TWO broad cream hind feet; TWO short gray forepaws resting naturally at the sides of the chest, slightly separated from torso, small round cream pom-pom tail centered at rear. Four limbs total. No clothing, no human hands, no elongated fingers, no realistic fur strands.

assets.name: 驴
assets.description: Chubby small gray donkey with an oversized friendly long head, broad cream muzzle with two subtle small nostril dimples, TWO very long upright gray ears with pink interiors, a short chunky dark-charcoal mane running from forehead down the back of the neck. Friendly blue-black eyes. Compact rounded body, small cream belly patch, FOUR separate short sturdy legs ending in dark hooves. A simple gray tail with rounded dark tuft at tip. Natural neutral quadruped standing pose, all four hooves grounded. Not a rabbit, not a horse; maintain the extra-long donkey ears.

assets.name: 普通水豚
assets.description: An ordinary farm capybara animal, on FOUR short sturdy legs: warm caramel-tan barrel-shaped body, large long blunt rectangular-rounded head projecting forward, small rounded ears placed high on the sides, compact eyes with dark blue-black pupils and small highlights, broad darker-tan muzzle with tiny subtle nostril slits and gentle mouth curve. Short thick neck and four small darker-brown rounded feet, no visible tail. Natural quadruped standing pose. Plain animal capybara, absolutely NO orange fruit, no hat, no shorts, no clothing, no human upright body, no Lulu mascot accessories.

assets.name: 鸵鸟
assets.description: Friendly stylized small ostrich with a plump dark charcoal oval body, pale pink small rounded head and long smooth pale-pink upright gently curved neck, small broad orange beak, large blue-black eyes. TWO folded chunky dark wings with broad cream-white feather-tip shapes and a short broad cream-white fan tail. TWO clearly separate long pink legs, each with a simple rounded TWO-TOED foot resting on ground. Same neutral standing pose, neck upright and relaxed. Not a goose or flamingo, not webbed feet, no extra legs. Feathers represented by a few broad smooth solid forms, not fine feathers.

assets.name: 小马
assets.description: A friendly chestnut-brown chubby pony with large rounded head and short broad cream muzzle, TWO small upright rounded triangular ears with pink inner faces, large blue-black eyes. Darker chocolate-brown mane made of a few thick smooth curved locks over forehead and down neck, a thick softly curved dark-brown tail, plump barrel body, FOUR short sturdy legs with dark brown rounded hooves. Natural relaxed quadruped stance, all hooves grounded. No saddle, bridle, horseshoes, horn or wings; mane and tail are solid sculpted masses, no hair strands.

assets.name: 白鹅
assets.description: A friendly ivory-white farm goose with small rounded head, noticeably LONGER/slimmer upright neck than the completed yellow duck, pear-shaped white body held horizontally, broad rounded orange beak, blue-black eyes with small highlights, TWO simple folded white wings, short slightly upturned white tail, TWO short orange legs with broad orange webbed feet on ground. Natural neutral goose stance; neck makes a gentle soft curve, not an exaggerated swan loop. Keep all plumage white/cream, not yellow; no duckling forehead tuft. No hats or accessories.

assets.name: 山羊
assets.description: A small chubby gray goat with cream-white face stripe, muzzle, chest and belly, friendly blue-black eyes and tiny pink nose, TWO thick short brown horns curving gently backward with rounded safe tips, TWO sideways slightly drooping gray ears with pink inner faces. Small cream rounded goatee beneath chin, compact gray body, short raised gray tail, FOUR short sturdy legs with dark brown hooves. Neutral quadruped stance with all hooves grounded. Not a sheep: smooth short coat, no wool lobes. Horns, beard and ears remain identical across views, no extra horns.

assets.name: 小鹿
assets.description: A young warm orange-tan fawn with large rounded head, TWO large upright rounded-point ears with pink interiors, friendly blue-black eyes, small dark-brown rounded nose, cream muzzle and chest/belly patch. Slender but soft rounded neck and body, FOUR short clearly separated legs with brown hooves, short raised tan tail with cream underside. Cream oval flank spots following the attached side view, continued consistently on the opposite side; use flat color markings, not raised geometry. NO antlers. Neutral relaxed quadruped standing pose, all hooves grounded, no accessories.

assets.name: 黑猪
assets.description: Exactly the SAME anatomy, pose and proportions as A02 pink pig, ONLY changing main pink body coat to soft charcoal-gray. Keep the snout pastel pink, inner ears warm pink, brown hooves, same curled tail and eye design. No new mesh should be generated when A02's mesh is available; reuse it with a new material variant.
